provider_receipt.summary: Review found unsupported completion and named defects: (1) src/lib.rs:87 serializes each MemoryRecord and immediately discards it, so MemoryStore::store provides no durable storage despite the documented persistence role; (2) src/lib.rs:15-25 and 119-124 omit the ingestion contract’s authority, source_type, privacy, review_required, provenance, and lifecycle controls, treating every scanned note—including raw, superseded, or quarantined material—as Semantic memory; (3) src/lib.rs:184-192 permits wikilinks containing ../ to resolve outside the configured vault and returns those external paths when they exist; (4) src/lib.rs:110-114 silently discards traversal and permission errors, allowing scan_vault to report success with incomplete results; and (5) src/lib.rs:152-158 accepts the first delimiter-shaped block anywhere in a document rather than requiring frontmatter at the file start. The only supplied verification evidence is a clean-tree check, which establishes non-modification but does not verify these behaviors or support implementation approval. No project files were modified and no declared checks were rerun.
